description: Defines a logging utility class 'Log' with conditional compilation for RDK logger integration or fallback to printf-based logging, including methods for various log levels and license information.

classes.name: omi::Log
classes.description: Logging utility class with static methods for different log levels, supporting both RDK logger and printf-based logging.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, either via RDK or as a no-op.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal message with printf-like formatting.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message with printf-like formatting.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with printf-like formatting.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Logs a notice message with printf-like formatting.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an informational message with printf-like formatting.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message with printf-like formatting.
